decision: Use Remotion instead of Runway + JSON2Video
rationale: Open-source, full control, saves $180-350/mo, React-based for flexibility and exact frame control
impact: Core infrastructure; all video production now uses Remotion TSX compositions

decision: Never use ElevenLabs without explicit permission
rationale: Prevents unauthorized API calls and credit consumption; user maintains control over VO generation vs extraction
impact: All VO generation must include --permission-granted flag or skip ElevenLabs entirely

decision: Extract voiceover from existing videos instead of regenerating
rationale: Prevents audio/video desync, saves 44% of ElevenLabs credits, ensures sync remains correct when visuals edited
impact: All VO updates now follow extraction + visual trim workflow, not regenerate + audio sync

decision: SVG diagrams minimum viewBox height 850px for 7-node radial layouts
rationale: Text cutoff failures in production revealed 700px insufficient; 850px provides 60px clearance below labels
impact: All radial diagrams must use viewBox height 850px+; prevents text clipping at diagram edges

rationale: Blank slide failures from oversized Sequence allocations; formula ensures composition ends when audio ends
impact: All Root.tsx durationInFrames must be validated against actual VO length before rendering

decision: Always commit submodule first, then commit main repo submodule pointer
rationale: Prevents stale pointers; main repo stores commit hash reference to submodule
impact: Git workflow requires 2-step commit: submodule → main repo, never reversed

decision: Final muxed videos go in updated/ folder, not video_production/
rationale: Separates rendered output (video_production/) from finalized deliverables (updated/)
impact: Publish workflow looks in updated/ for final videos; never ship from video_production/

decision: Implement 6-phase Context Engineering Harness for reliable Claude assistance across sessions
rationale: Document cutoff, frame count errors, text clipping failures repeated across sessions; harness encodes rules, tracks work, prevents mistakes
impact: Enables multi-session reliability: beads survive context resets, hooks enforce rules, docs encode institutional knowledge
